-- =============================================================================
-- Warehouse Geography Summary
-- =============================================================================
-- Purpose : Summarize warehouse distribution by country and state/province.
-- Scope   : All warehouses; no parameters, no row-level filters.
-- NULL    : NULL values in w_country / w_state are preserved as their own
--           group (no WHERE clause excludes them).
-- Dialect : MySQL (read-only).
-- =============================================================================

SELECT
    w.w_country,
    w.w_state,
    COUNT(*)                                         AS warehouse_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id)                 AS warehouse_id_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_city)                         AS city_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_county)                       AS county_count,
    -- -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- total_warehouse_sq_ft
    --   Source : warehouse.w_warehouse_sq_ft
    --            (registered metadata; column type INT, nullable)
    --   Unit   : square feet (sq_ft), as declared by the source column name.
    --   NULL   : SUM() ignores NULL values. If every warehouse in a
    --            group has w_warehouse_sq_ft = NULL, the result is NULL.
    -- -----------------------------------------------------------------
    SUM(w.w_warehouse_sq_ft)                         AS total_warehouse_sq_ft
FROM
    warehouse w
GROUP BY
    w.w_country,
    w.w_state
ORDER BY
    w.w_country,
    w.w_state;
title: TPCDS 248 仓库地理分布
description: 按国家和省州统计仓库及覆盖城市数量，返回每组实际仓库主键范围；全仓库维表，无参数。 增加仓库面积合计，单位仅以源端声明为准。

sqlTemplate:
-- ============================================================
-- warehouse_geography.sql
-- 仓库地理分布维表查询（无参数、只读、全量）
-- 口径：按国家(w_country)、省州(w_state)分组，
--       统计每组仓库数量、覆盖城市数量，
--       并返回该组最小/最大仓库主键(w_warehouse_sk)，
--       便于后续选择仓库开展库存分析。
-- 保留空值分组（不对 NULL 做过滤），按国家、省州升序排列。
-- 不固定任何商品或仓库，不添加人为业务过滤条件。
-- 数据来源：tpcds.warehouse（基于已注册元数据）
-- ============================================================

SELECT
    w_country,                                              -- 国家
    w_state,                                                -- 省州
    COUNT(*)                AS warehouse_count,             -- 该分组仓库数量
    COUNT(DISTINCT w_city)  AS city_count,                  -- 该分组覆盖城市数量
    MIN(w_warehouse_sk)     AS min_warehouse_sk,            -- 最小仓库主键
    MAX(w_warehouse_sk)     AS max_warehouse_sk             -- 最大仓库主键
FROM warehouse
GROUP BY
    w_country,
    w_state
ORDER BY
    w_country,
    w_state;
title: TPCDS 248 仓库地理分布
description: 按国家和省州统计仓库及覆盖城市数量，返回每组实际仓库主键范围；全仓库维表，无参数。
